concern: Verify touch target dimensions for interactive secondary controls adhere to the 44x44px minimum touch target size on 375px viewports.
jtbd: When interacting with secondary controls on a 375px mobile viewport, I want interactive touch targets to span at least 44x44px, so that I can reliably tap them without accidental touches or coordination strain.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a viewport width of 375px, When inspecting all interactive secondary controls, Then each element's touch target area (including hit area / padding) is at least 44x44 CSS pixels and spaced sufficiently from adjacent controls.
editInstruction: Update CSS rules for secondary interactive controls on mobile viewports (max-width: 375px) to enforce a minimum touch target dimension of 44x44px via min-height: 44px, min-width: 44px, or expanded transparent hitboxes.

concern: Ensure subtle muted text tokens retain >= 4.5:1 contrast against light container backgrounds across all monitor profiles.
jtbd: When reading subtle or secondary text on light container backgrounds, I want text color contrast to be at least 4.5:1, so that the information is effortlessly legible regardless of monitor calibration or lighting conditions.
acceptanceCriteria: Given text elements styled with muted color tokens rendered against light container backgrounds, When measured using WCAG 2.1 luminance algorithms, Then the contrast ratio is at least 4.5:1 for standard body text.
editInstruction: Darken the muted text color token used over light container backgrounds so that the computed WCAG color contrast ratio is greater than or equal to 4.5:1 while maintaining designated token hierarchy.
